info.name: Financial Analytics Dashboard
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Financial Analytics Dashboard backend (Express + MongoDB + JWT auth). Every route in the codebase is represented: Auth, Transactions, Analytics, Users, and a Health check.

Setup:
1. Set the `base_url` collection variable to your running backend (defaults to http://localhost:5050).
2. Run "Auth > Login" — its test script automatically saves the returned token into the `token` collection variable.
3. All other requests inherit a Bearer token auth using `{{token}}` from the collection level.

Default seed credentials (from backend/.env SEED_ADMIN_*): username `analyst`, password `Analyst@123`.

variable.description: Backend base URL. Swap to the Render deployment URL to hit production, e.g. https://your-app.onrender.com
JWT returned by POST /api/auth/login. Auto-populated by that request's test script; can also be set manually.

item.name: Health
item.description: Unauthenticated liveness check, mounted directly in app.ts (not under any resource router).

request.description: Basic liveness probe. No authentication required. Returns `{ status: "ok", timestamp: <ISO string> }`. Registered before Helmet/CORS in app.ts, so it always responds even if those reject the request elsewhere.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Login, current-session lookup, and logout. All routes except /login require a Bearer token.

request.description:
Logs in with username/password and returns a JWT. Rate-limited to 20 attempts per 15 minutes per IP.

Request body (required): `{ username: string, password: string }`.

Default seeded credentials: `analyst` / `Analyst@123` (from backend/.env SEED_ADMIN_USERNAME / SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD).

Response 200: `{ token: string, user: { id, username, name } }`.
Response 401: invalid username or password.

The test script on this request automatically stores the returned token in the `{{token}}` collection variable for use by every other request.

Returns the user derived from the JWT's claims (no DB lookup). Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`.

Response 200: `{ user: { id, username, name } }`.
Response 401: missing or invalid token.

JWTs are stateless — there is no server-side session to revoke. This endpoint exists purely so a real login/logout pair exists server-side; the token is actually invalidated by discarding it client-side. Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`.

Response 200: `{ message: string }`.
Response 401: missing or invalid token.

item.name: Transactions
item.description: Listing, aggregate summaries, per-user directory, stats, CSV/JSON export, and single-record lookup. All routes require a Bearer token.

query.description: Page number, 1-indexed. Default 1.
Rows per page, max 100. Default 10.
One of: date, amount, category, status, user_name. Default date.
asc or desc. Default desc.
Matches user name/id, category, status, or amount if the term is numeric.
Revenue or Expense.
Paid or Pending (case-insensitive; 'completed' is a synonym for Paid).
Exact user_id match.
ISO date, inclusive lower bound. Ignored if year is set.
ISO date, inclusive upper bound. Ignored if year is set.
Scopes to that calendar year; takes precedence over dateFrom/dateTo.
1-12. Narrows year to a single month; ignored without year.
Inclusive lower bound on amount.
Inclusive upper bound on amount.

request.description:
Paginated, filterable, sortable, searchable transaction list.

Response 200: `{ data: Transaction[], pagination: { page, limit, total, totalPages } }`.
Response 400: invalid query parameters.
Response 401: missing or invalid token.

query.description: Revenue or Expense.
Paid or Pending. Note: summary/expenses/balance are always Paid-only regardless of this filter.
Exact user_id match.
ISO date, inclusive lower bound.
ISO date, inclusive upper bound.
Scopes revenue/expenses/balance/categoryBreakdown/yearly to this year.
1-12. Requires year.
Inclusive lower bound on amount.
Inclusive upper bound on amount.
Advisory only: one of date, status, user, month, year. Doesn't change behavior by itself.
Matches user_id exactly or user_name as a substring — scopes recentTransactions only.
How many recentTransactions to return, max 50. Default 5.

request.description:
Dashboard summary: totals, category breakdown, yearly/monthly rollup, and recent transactions. Accepts the same filters as the list endpoint (no pagination/sort). Revenue/expenses/balance are always Paid-only regardless of the `status` filter passed. categoryBreakdown + yearly are cached briefly in memory; recentTransactions is always live.

Response 200: `{ summary: { balance, revenue, expenses }, categoryBreakdown: [...], yearly: {...}, recentTransactions: { data, total, limit } }`.
Response 401: missing or invalid token.

query.description: Required. Format YYYY-MM.
Required. Format YYYY-MM.
Paid, Pending, or all. Default Paid.

request.description:
Compares revenue/expenses/balance between two calendar months. Defaults to Paid-only; the response's `data.filter` states exactly which status was compared.

Response 200: `{ data: { filter, periodA: { period, revenue, expenses, balance }, periodB: {...}, difference: { revenue, expenses, balance } } }`.
Response 400: periodA/periodB not in YYYY-MM format.
Response 401: missing or invalid token.

Distinct transacting users found in the transaction dataset, for filter dropdowns. No query parameters.

Response 200: `{ users: [{ user_id, user_name, user_profile }] }`.
Response 401: missing or invalid token.

query.description: Paid, Pending, or all. Default Paid. Use 'all' to see the Paid-vs-Pending split in byStatus.

request.description:
Dataset stats: total count, total volume, breakdown by status, breakdown by category — all scoped by the same `status` filter.

Response 200: `{ data: { filter, totalCount, totalVolume, byStatus: [{status,count,total}], byCategory: [{category,count,total}] } }`.
Response 401: missing or invalid token.

Streams back a CSV file (Content-Disposition: attachment). `format` defaults to "csv" if omitted. `columns` defaults to all exportable columns if omitted: id, date, amount, category, status, user_id, user_name. `filters` accepts the same shape as the list endpoint's query filters.

Response 200: `text/csv` file body.
Response 404: no transactions match the given filters.
Response 401: missing or invalid token.

Same endpoint as the CSV export, with `format: "json"`. Streams back a JSON array of objects containing only the selected `columns`, with native types (amount as a number, date as a full ISO timestamp) rather than CSV's stringified cells.

Response 200: `application/json` array body, e.g. `[{ id, date, amount, category, status, user_id, user_name }, ...]`.
Response 404: no transactions match the given filters.
Response 401: missing or invalid token.

Fetches a single transaction by its Mongo _id.

Response 200: `{ data: Transaction }`.
Response 400: id is not a valid Mongo ObjectId.
Response 404: no transaction with that id.
Response 401: missing or invalid token.

item.name: Analytics
item.description: Aggregate KPI and cashflow endpoints, both Paid-only by default. All routes require a Bearer token.

query.description: Paid, Pending, or all. Default Paid.
Scopes all figures to one calendar year (UTC). Omit for all-time totals.

request.description:
Key metrics: revenue, expenses, balance, transaction count, average transaction value, top category. Defaults to Paid-only, all-time. count/averageTransactionValue always describe the exact same filtered set as revenue/expenses.

Response 200: `{ data: { filter, year, revenue, expenses, balance, transactionCount, averageTransactionValue, topCategory } }`.
Response 401: missing or invalid token.

query.description: Defaults to the latest year with data under the given status filter.
Paid, Pending, or all. Default Paid.

request.description:
Monthly cashflow (revenue minus expenses) for a year — always returns exactly 12 months. Defaults to Paid-only and to the most recent year that actually has data under that status filter, not the real calendar year the server is running in.

Response 200: `{ data: { year, filter, months: [{ month, revenue, expenses, cashflow }] } }`.
Response 401: missing or invalid token.

item.name: Users
item.description: Per-user financial summary, keyed by the transaction dataset's user_id. Requires a Bearer token.

variable.description: The transaction dataset's user_id (e.g. user_001) — not a login account.

request.description:
A single user's totals. revenue/expenses/balance are Paid-only; transactionCount counts every transaction for that user regardless of status.

Response 200: `{ data: { user_id, user_name, revenue, expenses, balance, transactionCount } }`.
Response 404: no transactions found for that user id.
Response 401: missing or invalid token.
